text: Alex tells Lena about a weekend trip to Hamburg. In this unit you will say what you did yesterday, at the weekend and on holiday, tell your own story (school, study, work, moves) and talk about a few dates in German history. You will use the perfect tense (Perfekt), the past forms war and hatte, and als. The scenes are set in places you may know: an office, a canteen, a train, a job interview and a museum.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
